_doc: Scripted routes for the golden-frame harness (tools/golden/golden.py). Times in `input` are seconds after the guest configures HID (NAPPLE_INPUT_SCRIPT); `frames` are presented frame numbers captured with NAPPLE_SCREENSHOT_FRAMES. Frame numbers depend on the machine's speed: routes are for an otherwise idle Mac (headless runs at 58-60 fps). Goldens are game screenshots and live OUTSIDE the repo (~/Library/Application Support/Napple/goldens/<title>/<route>/<frame>.png, or --golden-root); only this manifest is committed. `tolerance`: mean absolute difference per channel (0-255) on a 64x36 downsample, and `max_block`: the largest 8x8-block mean difference; either exceeded = the frame differs.

boot-to-village.notes: fresh save: the opening movie (VP9 + Vorbis, ~84 s, not skippable), title (5100: Press L+R), file select -> New Game -> difficulty Normal -> name (software keyboard applet returns "Link") -> OK, Link wakes in Tarin's house (6300), B through the dialogue, walk to the door (Tarin stops him), talk to Tarin, the shield (9700), out of the door into Mabe Village (10700, name banner). Verified headless on the Mac 2026-11-01 (sweep-media r2). Time-based input: needs an otherwise idle Mac at ~60 fps; 190 s is longer than the 120 s batch guideline because the unskippable movie takes 84 s

title-and-kingdom.notes: title menu, intro, first kingdom; 8000 and 9000 are the sleep/parrot scene (exploded-geometry regression)

airport-counter.notes: airport counter, dialogue; name entry and island arrival need a longer route
